result.report:
Your previous experiment regarding screen time resulted in a sleep quality change of 0.916. While this change is unlikely to be noise alone, it is not proof that the habit caused the improvement.

Regarding your next step, the data shows that bed_hour is the habit most linked with worse sleep. The correlation is -0.297 with a p-value of 0.0045, which is strong evidence of an association. This is an association and not a cause-and-effect relationship.

go to bed 30 minutes earlier
